title: Brex header
description: A 60px white bar with a hairline under it that stays pinned: wordmark and chevroned menu links on the left, a plain sign-in link, a demo link and an orange button on the right. On phones a menu icon and wordmark sit left and the orange button right; the menu opens a full-width panel.
notes: sticks to the top of the page (position: sticky), so it needs to sit directly in the page container
the phone menu is a native <details>; no JavaScript
name: brex-header

props.name: brand
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: the wordmark: a name in the display face with an optional small icon before it

props.name: secondary
props.description: the two plain links on the right, e.g. "Sign in" and "See a demo"

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button
